**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nguyenthdat/opencode-manager/compare/v0.3.0...v0.3.1

## Highlights

- Add a project-local Plugin Registry with the official `@sveltejs/opencode` integration, inherited-state detection, conflict handling, and backups.
- Add source-level **All skills** actions for installing or removing complete skill collections.
- Expand the commit-pinned vendor registry to 19 git sources with 720 validated skill bundles, including Hallmark, Vercel, Microsoft, Hugging Face, K-Dense, Qt, product, marketing, finance, and trading collections.
- Add a weekly GitHub Actions workflow that refreshes source revisions, validates every resulting source, and creates or updates a pull request without force-pushing.

## Safety And Validation

- Preserve JSONC comments and unrelated plugin entries during project config updates.
- Keep source symlink handling fail-closed by default, with explicit compatibility-mirror opt-in for Microsoft.
- Validate full commit SHAs, source layouts, skill manifests, generated artifacts, package contents, and dependency audit results.
- Pass 49 automated tests and clean-install verification of the published npm package.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nguyenthdat/opencode-manager/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.0
